data.title: Bugatti Residences
data.about:
Discover a home where nature's pristine beauty meets unparalleled luxury at Bugatti Residences by Binghatti. Nestled in the vibrant heart of Business Bay, this exclusive haven mirrors the organic grace and tranquility of the French Riviera, weaving a tapestry of elegance with its meticulously designed façade adorned with delicate contours and graceful curves.

Bugatti Residences offers a curated selection of residences, ranging from 2 to 4-bedroom Rivera Mansions to the pinnacle of luxury, the sky mansion penthouses, each reflecting a commitment to provide residents with an abode of supreme luxury and comfort. Beyond the confines of your exquisite home, a resort-inspired lifestyle awaits, characterized by serene man-made beaches offering a perfect sanctuary from the bustling world, just a step away from your doorstep.

characteristics_module.title: Indulge in the Buggati DNA:
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• World-First Collaboration: Bugatti x Binghatti, exclusive partnership, unmatched brand prestige, global icon
  • French Riviera Inspiration: Elegant curves, Riviera aesthetics, sophisticated luxury, iconic façade
  • Hyper-Exclusive Units: Limited-edition mansions, bespoke penthouses, curated layouts, ultimate privacy
  • Luxury Car Integration: Garage-to-penthouse lifts, automotive-inspired design, private valet, chauffeur services
  • Unparalleled Amenities: Private beach oasis, jacuzzi spa, chef’s table dining, private members club
  • Central Prestige Location: Prime Business Bay address, vibrant surroundings, urban convenience, cosmopolitan lifestyle
  • Exceptional Craftsmanship: Meticulous detailing, premium materials, custom interiors, architectural innovation

location_tile.title: Situated in a bustling metropolis!
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Located in the vibrant heart of Business Bay, Bugatti Binghatti ensures you are never far from Dubai's bustling lifestyle. Just moments away, you'll find a wealth of dining, shopping, and entertainment venues that cater to all your work and relaxation needs. Bugatti Residences redefine convenience, making it an integral part of your lifestyle.

  • 6 minutes from Burj Khalifa 
  • 8 minutes from DIFC
  • 10 minutes from Dubai Design District
  • 12 minutes from Dubai Creek Harbour
